description: Fetch a bridge-LINKED contract file on demand (Ticket T3). A document imported with modus 'referenz' holds only a link (source_meta.kind='bridge') and no bytes, so get_document_link / analyze_document have nothing to serve. This re-fetches the original through the bridge into the document store (sets its storage_path + file_size) so it can then be opened or analysed; the link metadata stays, and a later re-import resets it to a reference. If the document already has bytes it returns them unchanged. Required: document_id (a contract document, from list_documents / get_document). The bridge named in the link must be reachable.
name: resolve_contract_file
